criteria: RED: with FOUNDRY_PG_RESTORE a stub exiting 0 and an unreachable probe URL, backup-verify exits 0 and prints status: OK today
GREEN: an unreachable probe exits 8 with the probe named on stderr; a failing count on a present table exits 9; zero known Foundry tables exits 10; none print status: OK
Row counts and the schema DROP use sqlx in-binary with quoted identifiers; no psql anywhere in production code; only genuinely absent tables are skipped
@us-03-cli scenarios green on a host without psql; the whole us-03 feature and the workspace stay green
ci.yml drops postgresql-client-16; exit codes 8-10 documented; fmt, clippy -D warnings, check-arch pass
steps.scenario_name: The `foundry doctor backup-verify` CLI subcommand reports row counts and exits zero on a healthy backup
steps.description: Regression-first: a hermetic test proves backup-verify reports a false OK when it cannot count. Then replace the two bare psql calls with in-binary sqlx (count via to_regclass + count(*), quoted DROP) and make every failure other than a genuinely absent table exit non-zero without status: OK.
steps.implementation_notes: See docs/feature/fix-backup-verify-fail-open/rca.md. main is #[tokio::main]: use the existing std::thread::spawn + new_current_thread runtime pattern (admin_cli.rs ~290-312), never block_on in place. Use one sqlx PgConnection / max_connections(1) pool with acquire timeout; not Store::connect; never migrate. Escape identifiers by doubling '"'. Never DROP the public schema. Exit codes 2-7 already exist. Run lanes with `timeout`; clean leftover testcontainers after.
